reason: Root selected a smaller first V17 concurrency boundary before any V17 physical run.

first_V17_boundary.receive_and_decode: One background ROS SingleThreadedExecutor retains its actual callback order and decodes in that same thread.
first_V17_boundary.commit: Bounded ready FIFO, consumed by one main mapper owner. All buffer commits, IMU propagation, sync and LIO/VIO remain main-owner serial.
first_V17_boundary.timers: Timer events enter that same ready FIFO and execute on owner.
first_V17_boundary.original_receipt: Captured at each callback entry; raw diagnostics written by main owner with original receipt preserved.
first_V17_boundary.explicit_limit: Heavy decoding can still briefly block the receive executor. A separate decoder is a later candidate requiring new prospective audit.
pure_gates: FIFO is bounded and preserves actual receipt callback sequence without drops or overwrites
Timer and measurement events preserve documented global dispatch order
Decoded data bits equal V12 decoder outputs for same raw inputs
Shutdown drains or explicitly rejects remaining events; never report missing as valid
Sequence, receipt, decode completion, enqueue, dequeue/commit and watermark trace
